name: Jingai Danshi Encounter: Werewolf wa Washatto Shitai
original_name: 人外男子エンカウント ワ―ウルフはわしゃっとしたい
source:
One day, while Heather is on her way to buy some herbs, a werewolf stops her in her tracks. Then, he asks...

"Could you ruffle my fur?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22353]Freem![/url]]
